name: Ring of Starvation
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of sustenance. Once the ring is worn the wearer is struck with a constant feeling of hunger, giving a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and skill checks. Spell casters must make a successful concentration check (DC 10 + spell level) to cast spells while wearing the ring.

The wearer must consume five times the normal amount of food per day to keep the hunger from overwhelming her. Failure to do so results in 1d3 points of Constitution damage and 1d6 points of non-lethal damage.

This ring can be removed by casting remove curse followed by restoration upon it. Doing so destroys the ring, turning it to dust.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of sustenance

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
